answer: Each identity must lock a bond that doubles per linked registration from the same funding source: 50 POA for the first, 100 for the second, 200 for the third, held for 30 epochs. Like trees in a grove sharing roots, accounts funded within 2 hops are clustered in an atlas, so splitting identities multiplies locked capital rather than influence. Every epoch, 5 verifiers re-check signatures and bond balances; a lapsed or reused bond is slashed 20%. The nectar of rewards vests only after 100 epochs, so a sybil operator pays rising costs before payout, while one honest agent pays once.
